note: The naturalist's notes (docs/future/11, doc 13), read by src/world/expansion.js. Each kind of find you discover (journal.json findOrder, a page known) adds a mark to the line at the top of Small lives. At a reward's mark (at: kinds found) the island gives it once, for good: give is merged into the saved unlocks (shells: the sea starts leaving shells on the strandline; stones: a handful of loose stones comes by itself near fresh water, and Sculpt offers Loose stone, recipes/world/pieces.json; driftwood: logs wash up on the strandline after high tides, pieces.json driftwood, and you can carry them, src/app.js unlocks.carry). A reward with no give is not built yet: it shows on the line in pencil, with its hint, and is given later. title and line are the reward card and its journal note; icon is drawn from src/ui/icons; page is the journal page the note opens. hint is the pencil word beside the next reward on the trail. line: the words of its page (src/ui/journal.js naturalistView), a trail down the paper with one row per stop: title, entry (the row in Small lives that opens it), intro (under the title), next (under the next reward's hint), later (under a reward reached but not built yet) and where (a small line under a find's stop saying where it was found: the life under a log, L3a). Species gifts (doc 13) come through the same module: a species' gift (its recipe's gift, e.g. frog.json) is given the first time one of them comes to know you: a frog or a turtle named, the minnows or dragonflies trusting you to their presence.knownTrust (the flag <species>:known; Matt, October 27, 2026, was the first time it was happy); gifts holds the card words per kind of gift, with {species} and {plant} filled in: one set for every seed, and for tools one set per tool id (gifts.tool.cliffs, the frogs' Cliff tool; gifts.tool.springs, the dragonflies' springs), each with its own drawn icon. card.showS: how long the card stays before it fades (a tap closes it sooner).

rewards.title: The sea has started leaving shells
rewards.line: Walk the strandline after a high tide. The rarest come with the biggest tides.

rewards.title: Loose stones have turned up
rewards.line: Tap one to look underneath. With Loose stone under Sculpt you can set more.

rewards.title: Driftwood has started washing up
rewards.line: Look along the strandline after a high tide. Tap a log to look at it, and carry it up to keep it before the sea takes it back.

rewards.hint: a way to read the tides
a way to look far out
a way to see by night

line.title: The naturalist's notes
line.entry: Your trails: what you notice, what you keep and what you make.
line.intro: What you have found along the shore and the water, in the order you found it.
line.layerNote: A layer under the ground, seen.

seed.title: A gift from the {species}
seed.line: Seeds of {plant}, waiting on your gift spot. Go down, pick them there, and toss them wherever they would grow.

cliffs.title: A gift from the {species}
cliffs.line: You can build terraces and cut cliffs now. Look for Terrace and Cut under Sculpt.

springs.title: A gift from the {species}
springs.line: You can make springs now. Look for Spring under Water. A spring above a terrace pours over its edge.

raft.title: A gift from the {species}
raft.line: A raft of reeds is waiting on your gift spot. Go down, pick it there, and set it on a pond. Turtles bask on it, far from the bank, and it rises and falls with the water.
